source_refs.note: Topic 4.1.5 Using Queues in Computers (PDF 102, printed 99).

blocks.text: Queues are used for breadth-first search in graphs, task scheduling, print spooling and call-centre systems.

blocks.prompt: Why does a call centre use a queue for waiting callers?
blocks.explanation: So callers are answered in the order they called: first in, first out.

items: Queue uses: BFS, task scheduling, print spooling, call centres, buffering.
